purpose: Source-grounded correction recommendations for merged expanded records. Recommendations only; no partition files were modified.
methodNotes: Official URLs are retained for every finding.
Evidence is paraphrased, not copied; no source passage exceeds 25 quoted words.
Location corrections compare the same official requisition captured in the ATS expansion; a placeholder US state is never accepted as a real state.
Unknown degree, experience type, and graduation information stays unknown until the official posting establishes it.
